snippet.title: Puzzling Places - Monthly Pack #8: Antique Treasures
snippet.description:
A brand new puzzle pack - the "Monthly Pack #8: Antique Treasures" is here! 

Uncover pieces of history in this collection of fascinating statues, gadgets, and relics. Available today for $4.99 through the in-game or through the Quest / PS VR stores.

For more detailed information about the puzzle pack, refer to the announcement post here: https://puzzlingplaces.ghost.io/m8
